entities.summary: A Calandreta is a bilingual school in Southern France where the Occitan language is a medium of instruction, alongside French. These schools are based on the same principle as the Diwan schools of Brittany, as well as the Gaelscoileanna movement in Ireland, Ikastolak in the Basque Country, Ysgolion Meithrin in Wales, and La Bressola of Northern Catalonia.
